title: Vectras Enprocon IPO Details
intro:
Vectras Enprocon IPO is a book build issue of ₹53.05 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 40.56 lakh shares aggregating to ₹42.59 crores and offer for sale of 9.96 lakh shares aggregating to ₹10.46 crores.

Vectras Enprocon IPO opens for subscription on Oct 30, 2026 and closes on Nov 3, 2026. The allotment for the Vectras Enprocon IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 4, 2026. Vectras Enprocon IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 6, 2026.

Vectras Enprocon IPO is set issue price band at ₹99 to ₹105 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,200 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,52,000 (2,400 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (3,600 shares), amounting to ₹3,78,000.

Beeline Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Spread X Securities Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Vectras Enprocon IPO RHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Vectras Enprocon IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Vectras Enprocon IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Vectras Enprocon IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Vectras Enprocon IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.question: How to apply for Vectras Enprocon IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Vectras Enprocon IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Vectras Enprocon IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Vectras Enprocon IPO will be done on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Nov 5, 2026 . Check the Vectras Enprocon IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Vectras Enprocon IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Nov 6, 2026 .
